column1: # Batch 46 rejects, kept as data rather than dropped (2026-10-19).
# 899 candidate layers were discovered by asking 195 ArcGIS service roots for their own
# directory; 819 answered /query with real records. These 80 did not, and each says why.
#   NO_QUERY        the layer exists in the directory but its /query endpoint refuses
#                   (no query capability, or a 200 carrying an error body)
#   EMPTY_RESULTSET it answers and holds nothing — a source guaranteed to emit nothing
#                   on every run, which is what CLAUDE.md calls the invisible nothing
#   NO_ID_FIELD     no objectIdField and no OBJECTID/FID: every uid would be a content
#                   hash, so a record that CHANGES becomes a new row instead of an update
#   NET_ERR/HTTP_ERR one reading, not a property — these may be a bad afternoon
# A further 739 PASS layers were not selected: deduped (the same layer under the ArcGIS/arcgis
# and MapServer/FeatureServer spellings), under the 50-record floor, cartography by name
# (hillshade, contour, tile index), or beyond this batch's 2-per-root cap and 165 target.
